item.title: Communal bin left on the pavement, 5th September
item.description:
This is a recurring issue. The bin store for number 12 Marshalsea Road is constantly overflowing with rubbish, which covers the pavement. At the moment, the bin store is full of fly-tipped trash, and as a result, their bin sits on the pavement. We have reported this problem several times, and although you collect the trash left on the street, the problem is recurring, so it requires a long-term solution. In this case, the bin store is full of trash that needs to be collected so that the communal bin can be stored inside.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Disney Place, The Borough, Greater London
